final_metrics: matured labels at H+W; no additional opportunities after H
other_comparisons_scope: secondary/descriptive; not additional unadjusted primary hypothesis claims
primary_estimand: development-selected strongest deployable point vs development-tuned arrived-only feedback; no generative novelty claim

selection.diagnostic_scope: past-outcome feedback heuristic; not a global optimum or proof that no better policy exists
selection.history_contract: Each deployment context supplies its own frozen mature TRAIN history. Context-specific history is matched and stable; the policy gets neither test delay parameters nor context/regime labels. This does not infer unknown delay regimes or handle drift.
selection.mature_only_scope: Mature-cohort calibration plus pending imputation. H=W=48 provides no fully mature live cohort, so calibration remains the prior MAP; this is not a controller that discards all immature conversions.
selection.selection_scope: best macro development score within each estimator; confirmation protection gates remain binding
